items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 5:1
items.html: After the departure of the ten Sefirot of direct light from within the ten Sefirot of reflected light that clothed them, the reflected light remains below in the discernment of “coarse and gross light,” since they are empty of light. Their coarseness is then revealed and they are recognised as a vessel. Indeed, before the direct light expanded out of the reflected light, the two of them were as though mixed with one another. (Part 4, Chapter 6, Item 2)
